title: Admission Process
content: The admission process at SRM Institute of Science and Technology (SRMIST) is conducted online. Candidates must apply through the official SRM admission portal (applications.srmist.edu.in). For engineering (B.Tech) programs, admission is primarily based on the rank obtained in the SRM Joint Engineering Entrance Examination (SRMJEEE). The process involves: 1. Online registration and filling out the application form. 2. Uploading required documents (10th/12th marksheets, photo, signature). 3. Payment of the application fee. 4. Booking exam slots and downloading the SRMJEEE admit card. 5. Appearing for the online proctored SRMJEEE exam. 6. Participating in online counselling based on SRMJEEE rank where students select their preferred campus and specialization. 7. Allocation of seats, document verification, and payment of the tuition fee to secure admission. Direct admission is also available for top rankers of national/state level boards and competitive exams like JEE Main.
